body:
New project `robofab-slipcrit`, a follow-up to `robofab-sliprate`. It tests whether judging a gripped bar by extrapolated creep (2 mm in 3 s) makes the MuJoCo "holds" verdict independent of solver settings. It does not: the spread across 8 settings is 33x to 400x or more, close to a 1 degree tolerance. Stylised, negative, one engine.

Checks: 5 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added, figure committed.
